description: The trailhead is located at the Roscoe Lake Recreation Site. The 0.7 km well marked trail leads to a "bluffs" vantage point. The trail also splits and leads to Knight (Echo)Lake located approx 0.8 km further along the trail. Overall to hike both trails would be 3.0 km in length, round trip.

stats.Activity Details: Picnicking, Wildlife Viewing, Nature Study, Viewing, Hiking

title: Roscoe Lk Trail
